data.title: Inside the Chinese factory building humanoid robots for the world
data.description: Humanoid robots are breaking marathon records, performing backflips before crowds, and squaring off in MMA-style bouts. Now, CNN is getting a rare look at where some of them are made.
data.author: Dhruv Tikekar
